symptom: `mxcli new --version 10.24.0` printed "Project created" and exited 0, but the first build failed: mx check reports 4x CE6083 "Design property Flex container / Align items Y / Disable row wrap / Grow / shrink (self) is not supported by your theme" on MyFirstModule.App_Default's topbarContent
cause: Two defects. (1) The scaffold layout hardcoded Atlas 4's flex design properties, but Atlas is versioned with the project: 10.24's template ships Atlas Core 3.17, whose design-properties.json has no flex group at all. (2) `new` treated every first-build failure as a warning, including mxbuild refusing the MODEL, so a project that does not build was reported as created with exit 0
insight: Generated MDL that writes design properties must be filtered by the project's own themesource, not by the Mendix major mxcli was tested on. Nothing fails on Atlas 3 without them: its `.topbar-content` rule is already `display: flex; align-items: center`. `mxcli check -p` could not have caught it either: `documentWidgets` covers pages and snippets but not `create layout`, so the test feeds the layout's widget tree to `ValidateDesignPropertiesForStatement` as a snippet, an oracle that reproduced exactly the 4 CE6083 keys. Only a model error is fatal (mxbuild's `ERROR at` lines); a missing JDK says nothing about the project and stays a warning. Measured: 10.24.0 mx check 4 errors before, 0 after; 11.6.6 0 both, flex props kept; with the filter stubbed out, `new` now exits 1 listing the 4 errors
